item.title: Report account totals by currency
item.brief: Implement the reports portion of the shared contract. Read CSV stdin, aggregate per account and currency, emit header account,currency,total_cents and sorted account then currency. Legacy CSV lacking currency is treated as USD. Validate any present currency as exactly three uppercase ASCII letters; malformed input prints an error to stderr and exits 2. Update README and keep/add appropriate coverage, then run python3 -m unittest and commit the change in this repository.

item.title: Add currency support to ledger TSV to CSV conversion
item.brief:
Implement the ledger portion of the shared contract. Parse optional fourth TSV field as currency; default to USD. Enforce exactly three uppercase ASCII letters. Emit currency column in header and each row. Invalid currency must print an error naming input line number to stderr and exit 2; preserve status 1 for other input errors. Update README and keep/add appropriate coverage, then run cargo test and commit the change in this repository.
